change.summary: Keep Paraglider's finite natural-spawner reward while denying repeat rewards from player-placed spawners

modifiers.before: Every broken minecraft:spawner qualifies, including the same Mineable Spawner block after repeated placement
modifiers.after: Natural spawners retain Paraglider's configured reward, while a player-placed spawner is persistently marked and denied the modifier reward
conditions: The loot context contains the placed spawner block entity
modifiers.notes: The generic spawner item, native Paraglider reward count and ordinary spawner behavior remain owned by their original mods

rationale.purpose: Close an infinite Spirit Orb loop without deleting the intended exploration reward
rationale.user_requested: Prevent repeatedly breaking and replacing a movable spawner from farming unlimited Paraglider Spirit Orbs
rationale.codex_choices: Persist player-placement provenance on the spawner block entity and suppress only Paraglider's reward for that provenance

introduced.summary: Mark player-placed spawners and reject their Paraglider Spirit Orb modifier reward

history.summary: Preserve the first natural-spawner reward while making every later placement ineligible

relations: Player placement -> persistent spawner provenance -> Paraglider modifier admission
Natural spawner break -> unchanged Paraglider configured Spirit Orb reward
Mineable generic spawner item -> later placement -> no renewable Spirit Orb reward
notes: Spawner contents, Silk Touch handling, spawning rules and Paraglider's reward count are unchanged
A previously placed unmarked spawner can grant at most one transitional reward before its next placement receives provenance
